body:
First preview release of LogLift for DJI, a macOS app for local DJI Log color conversion.

- Requires macOS 14 or later.
- Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- Includes 64 LUT files and 36 product image entries.
- Supports English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

Download `DJI-LogLift-0.1.0-universal.dmg`, open it, and drag **LogLift for DJI** to **Applications**. License texts and third-party notices are included in the disk image.

The app and disk image have Developer ID signatures and secure timestamps. The app uses Hardened Runtime and App Sandbox. Apple notarization accepted the final disk image; its ticket is stapled and validated. Gatekeeper accepted both the final disk image and the app mounted from it. Regression checks passed: 7 Python tests and 73 Swift tests.

This is a preview release. A clean Mac or VM test of quarantine-aware download, offline installation, and first launch is still pending. Intel execution has not been tested on an Intel Mac. These checks remain required before a production release.

Source commit: `942c723018048c8a2ebde40ac98a762657a0d1c5`. Version: 0.1.0, build 1.

SHA-256 of the final DMG:

```text
1e42e3669871d16f16db5b3948faa7c9f7801abf5b5258abb6c7ea38ff28e10c
```

See [LICENSING.md](https://github.com/huihuisang/DJI-LogLift/blob/master/LICENSING.md). DJI materials and trademarks are excluded from those grants; their redistribution permission remains unverified. LogLift is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DJI.
